name: Ancestral Worship
overview: Scripture clearly condemns ancestral worship by warning God's people not to imitate the abominable practices of surrounding nations or serve their gods, including those their ancestors followed beyond the flood (Deuteronomy 18:9; Joshua 23:7; Joshua 24:15). The Bible distinguishes between praising the living God and the silence of the dead, affirming that those who have passed away cannot praise the LORD (Psalms 71:8; Psalms 115:17). Instead, believers are called to exalt and trust in the faithful and true counsel of God, focusing worship solely on Him (Isaiah 25:1).
